summary: The most useful variants reduce repeated noise, make each claim auditable, and turn accepted findings into bounded engineering work.

items.text: Use an incremental report that analyzes only evidence changed since the last successful run, while periodically executing a full baseline to detect long-term drift.
Record reviewer dispositions, rejected recommendations, and superseded findings as durable decision memory; future runs must cite rather than rediscover them.
Promote an accepted recommendation only after it receives an owner, acceptance test, and executable safety-net target; otherwise keep it as an observation with an expiry date.
Add a bidirectional reconciliation mode in which confirmed report findings update the companion view and resolved work closes the original finding by stable ID.
